summary: Who arms a green+CLEAN trusted non-release PR that the auto-enable workflow left unarmed: the dispatch session, in its tick, via cli-merge-if-eligible --arm

options.description: dispatch runs node pipeline-cli/bin/cli-merge-if-eligible.mjs <pr> --source-kind backlog --arm on any green+CLEAN trusted non-release PR its tick finds unarmed; the CLI refuses ineligible PRs; the release PR stays operator-only
nobody arms by hand; wait for the auto-enable workflow to re-fire
the planner session runs the arm itself

body: Planner tick 2026-10-14 01:05Z asked dispatch to arm #1509 and #1510 via cli-merge-if-eligible --arm. Dispatch refused: arming is not on its operational list and a relayed message is not authority. The repository already permits this path: .ai-sdlc/agent-role.yaml governance.allowMerge=onGreenClean names cli-merge-if-eligible as the only landing path, and the CLI itself enforces policy, fork, author, base, task and head-commit checks and refuses anything ineligible. This record only names which session runs it. Velocity impact: positive (unarmed green PRs no longer wait for a planner tick). Five-step: requirement questioned (arming is already sanctioned, nothing new is permitted); delete (no planner relay per PR); simplify (one actor: dispatch); accelerate (arm on the tick that finds the PR green); automate (dispatch tick, not a person).
